name: Masor Tenga
ingredients: Elephant apple (Ou tenga) or dried mangosteen (Thekera)
instructions: 1. Marinate the fish pieces with turmeric and salt, then shallow fry in mustard oil until golden; set aside.
2. In the same oil, add fenugreek seeds and slit green chilies to temper.
3. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft, then add turmeric powder.
4. Add the souring agent (elephant apple or Thekera) and pour in water to create a thin broth.
5. Bring the gravy to a boil and add the fried fish pieces.
6. Simmer for a few minutes until the flavors infuse, then garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
description: Masor Tenga is a signature Assamese sour fish curry, highly valued for its digestive properties and light, refreshing flavor. It is a staple in Assamese households, typically served as the final main course with steamed rice to cleanse the palate.
